action.prompt:
param(
    [string]$WorkspaceRoot = 'D:\ecdsa-ocaml',
    [string]$SessionId     = '1789462133168_k6kyu'
)

Set-Location $WorkspaceRoot

# ---- 1. Ask kiro for the next command ----

$kiroPrompt = @"
You are working on the Dune/OCaml project at $WorkspaceRoot.

CURRENT STATE:
- lib/common builds clean
- lib/crypto/field.ml, field.mli, scalar.ml, scalar.mli, point.ml, point.mli exist
- lib/crypto/dune exists
- The build has warnings or errors

GOAL: propose the single most important command to fix the next problem
so that ``opam exec -- dune build`` progresses.

Respond in EXACTLY this format, nothing else:

CMD: <one PowerShell command, single line>
WHY: <one sentence>

No plans. No explanations. If nothing needs fixing, respond: DONE
"@

Write-Host "=== asking kiro ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
$kiroOut = & kiro --id $SessionId --non-interactive $kiroPrompt 2>&1 | Out-String
Write-Host $kiroOut

if ($kiroOut -match '(?m)^\s*DONE\s*$') {
    Write-Host "kiro reports nothing to fix." -ForegroundColor Green
    exit 0
}

$m = [regex]::Match($kiroOut, '(?m)^\s*CMD:\s*(.+)$')
if (-not $m.Success) {
    Write-Host "kiro produced no CMD line." -ForegroundColor Yellow
    exit 1
}

$cmd = $m.Groups[1].Value.Trim()

# ---- 2. Hand the command to cline ----

Write-Host "`n=== cline will execute ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host $cmd -ForegroundColor Yellow

$clinePrompt = @"
Execute this exact PowerShell command in $WorkspaceRoot:

    $cmd

Run it verbatim. Do not modify it. Do not rephrase it. Do not run any
other command. Do not add verification steps. Execute only this command
and report its raw output.
"@

Write-Host "`n=== cline output ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
& cline --auto-approve:true --cwd $WorkspaceRoot --non-interactive $clinePrompt 2>&1 | Write-Host

# ---- 3. Show the resulting build state ----

Write-Host "`n=== build state after cline ===" -ForegroundColor Cyan
& powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "opam exec -- dune build 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 40"
